name: A purchase order's promised_at instant must fall strictly within the exact proleptic Gregorian calendar month of plan_month (including Feb 28 non-leap vs Feb 29 leap years).

payload.rationale: A purchase order's promised_at instant must fall strictly within the exact proleptic Gregorian calendar month of plan_month (including Feb 28 non-leap vs Feb 29 leap years).

response.expression: all([seconds_between(timestamp(self.period_start), timestamp(self.order.promised_at))] as b0, (b0 >= 0) and all([days_between(date(take(self.plan_month, 4) + '-03-01'), date(self.period_month_date))] as b1, b0 < (((b1 == -28) ? 28 : ((b1 == -29) ? 29 : (((((b1 == 31) or (b1 == 92)) or (b1 == 184)) or (b1 == 245)) ? 30 : 31))) * 86400)))
